# Embedded emissions cannot be calculated: country of production is missing

The ruleset requires three inputs before any calculation:

| Required input | Provided | Status |
|---|---|---|
| (a) CN code in table | 7201 (Pig iron) | ✅ In table |
| (b) Country of production listed for that good | *blank* | ❌ Missing |
| (c) Quantity in tonnes | 1,500 t | ✅ Provided |

The default SEE depends on both the CN code and the country. CN 7201 has three country-specific values in the table:

| Country | Default SEE (tCO2e/t) |
|---|---|
| Türkiye | 1.85 |
| China | 1.66 |
| India | 2.53 |

These differ substantially, so no factor can be chosen without the country. The ruleset says not to estimate when a required input is missing, so I have not used a default, an average, or a range.

The other fields on the form ("blast furnace" and "Works 2") don't identify the country and aren't used in the default-value method.

**To finish the calculation, please provide the country of production for the Works 2 installation.** The result will then be:

> Embedded emissions (tCO2e) = SEE (CN 7201, country) × 1,500 t, rounded half-up to 2 decimal places

If the country is not Türkiye, China, or India, this table has no default value for it, and the calculation still can't be done under this ruleset.
